Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 230 of 2024
Applicant :- Vinay Kumar Mishra And Others
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, Lko.

And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Anoop Kumar Upadhyay
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.
Heard Sri Anoop Kumar Upadhyay, leanred counsel for the applicants, Sri Sanjay Maurya, learned A.G.A. for the State and Sri Abhishek Kumar, learned counsel appearing for opposite party No.2.
Vakalatnama filed by Sri Abhishek Kumar, Advocate is taken on record.

2. By means of the instant application filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C., the applicants have prayed for quashing of the entire proceedings of Case No.200 of 2021: State vs Vinay Kumar Mishra & Ors pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate-I, Balrampur arising out of Charge-sheet No.1 of 2020 dated 12.12.2020 under Sections 323, 504, 506, 498A IPC, 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Maharajganj Tarai, District Balrampur arising out of FIR/Case Crime No.180 of 2020.

entities.text: State vs Vinay Kumar Mishra & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsels for the parties submit that they have settled their dispute amicably outside the Court and they have arrived at the compromise.
Compromise entered into between the parties have been placed on record as Annexure-3 to the petition.

The parties have confirmed the terms of the Vinay Kumar Mishra And Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, ... on 11 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46606609/
1 compromise.

entities.text: Vinay Kumar Mishra And Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Compromise has been verified between the parties by learned Judicial Magistrate-I,
Balrampur vide order dated 23.11.2023 in compliance of the order dated 13.10.2023 passed by this Court in Application u/s 482 No.10045 of 2023.
4. I have considered the submissions of learned counsel for the parties.

5. Considering the ratio laid down by the Supreme Court in the cases of B. S. Joshi and others versus State of Haryana and another :(2003) 4 SCC 675, Nikhil Merchant versus C.B.I. and another :
(2008) 9 SCC 677, Manoj Sharma versus State and others : (2008) 16 SCC 1, Gian Singh versus Station of Punjab: (2010) 15 SCC 118 and Narinder Singh and others versus State of Punjab and another: (2014) 6 SCC 466, it would be appropriate in the facts and circumstances of the case to quash the criminal proceedings as continuance of the criminal proceedings would be an exercise in futility.

sentences.text:
6. In view of the fact that the parties have settled their dispute outside the Court by way of compromise arrived at between the parties and law laid down by the Supreme Court of India, the present petition is allowed and proceedings Case No.200 of 2021: State vs Vinay Kumar Mishra &
Ors pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate-I, Balrampur arising out of Charge-sheet No.1 of 2020 dated 12.12.2020 under Sections 323, 504, 506, 498A IPC, 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act,
Police Station Maharajganj Tarai, District Balrampur arising out of FIR/Case Crime No.180 of 2020 are hereby quashed.
